governing_standard: W33 Golden Learning & Assessment Standard v1.0
contract_rules: 1. Component mounting alone is strictly insufficient for E2E_VERIFIED.
2. E2E_VERIFIED requires MOUNT_VERIFIED + INTERACTION_VERIFIED + COMPLETION_VERIFIED + PERSISTENCE_VERIFIED + ASSESSMENT_VERIFIED (if applicable).
3. Interaction exceptions MUST fail the test and cannot be caught/swallowed.
4. All state transitions, XP awards, and persistence keys must be validated.

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click Next through scenes 1 to 5, then click Hoàn thành & Về map
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Active scene reaches index 4 and completeQuest('33', 'gear1_webtoon') is called
tasks.expected_XP_behavior: Milestone quest (0 direct XP, records milestone completion)
tasks.required_negative_guards: Empty initial state cannot show completion badge; refresh retains complete status
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: DOM progression 1..5 observed, store flag true, surviving reload

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click Start/Play, observe audio playback start, then click Complete
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Playback ticks start and completeQuest('33', 'gear2_karaoke') is called
tasks.expected_XP_behavior: Milestone quest (0 direct XP, milestone badge)
tasks.required_negative_guards: Cannot complete without triggering playback flow
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Waveform/Karaoke active state observed, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click Record/Start, trigger audio capture, click Finish/Submit
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Voice recording submitted and completeQuest('33', 'gear3_retell') called
tasks.required_negative_guards: Cannot award double XP on second click
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Recording submission observed, store flag true, XP incremented

tasks.required_user_interactions: Play article audio, answer comprehension drill option, click Complete
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Drill question answered and completeQuest('33', 'gear4_clil') called
tasks.required_negative_guards: Wrong drill option gives feedback; correct option passes
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Option selected, audio loaded, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Select friction material item (e.g. Ice/Glass), place in drop zone, click Check
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Drop zone populated and completeQuest('33', 'science_lab') called
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Item dropped in zone, check evaluated, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click word pills to populate structured report sentence frames, click Submit
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Sentence frame filled with >= 20 words, completeQuest('33', 'science_report') called
tasks.expected_media_behavior: Static word pills render without missing assets
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Pills clicked into slots, submission evaluated, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click matching word card and definition card, click Finish
tasks.expected_media_behavior: Vocab audio clips available on click
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Match interaction evaluated, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click word blocks in grammatical sequence, click Check
tasks.required_negative_guards: Wrong block order fails check and allows retry
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Blocks assembled into sentence, check passes, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Fill input with numeric answer '60', click Submit
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Correct answer entered and completeQuest('33', 'math_quest') called
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Numeric answer evaluated, bar model SVG visible, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Enter story continuation in textarea (>=20 words), click Submit Story
tasks.required_negative_guards: Short story (<20 words) shows length warning
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Text entered, rubric evaluated, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Play video prompt, record talkshow response, click Complete
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Talkshow response completed and completeQuest('33', 'broadcast_studio') called
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Video prompt loaded, response recorded, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click cue question button (What/Where/When), listen to examiner audio, click Finish
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Cue questions interacted and completeQuest('33', 'info_exchange') called
tasks.required_negative_guards: Dual shape adapter binds both legacy and modern card schemas
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Cue prompts clicked, examiner audio played, store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Play Part 1 audio, draw line to name pill, play Part 2 audio, complete notepad text
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Listening assessment submitted, MockAssessmentEngine computes 1..5 shields, completeQuest('33', 'boss_listening') called
tasks.required_negative_guards: Empty answers cannot trigger completion; duplicate submission does not increase score
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Line drawn, note completed, shield calculated in [1, 5], store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Select word bank item, match to definition card, repeat for items, click Submit
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Definitions matched, MockAssessmentEngine computes 1..5 shields, completeQuest('33', 'boss_reading') called
tasks.expected_assessment_behavior: Reading & Writing Shields awarded strictly within [1, 5]
tasks.required_negative_guards: Unmatched definitions cannot submit without warning
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Matches made, shield computed in [1, 5], store flag true

tasks.required_user_interactions: Click calibrated difference hotspots on side-by-side images, click Submit
tasks.valid_completion_condition: Differences identified, MockAssessmentEngine computes 1..5 shields, completeQuest('33', 'weekly_review') called
tasks.expected_assessment_behavior: Speaking Shields awarded strictly within [1, 5]; weekly total bounded in [0, 15]
tasks.required_negative_guards: Missing hotspots reduce raw score accordingly; refresh preserves final weekly shields
tasks.evidence_required_for_E2E_VERIFIED: Hotspots clicked, speaking shields calculated in [1, 5], store flag true
